rows.en: Let's go over the basics of Fighter mode.
rows.notes: Tutorial conventions set here: direction keys = 'D-pad', analog pad = 'analog stick', form = 'mode', shooting/melee attacks. | review: refit: 'basic controls for' -> 'basics of' (matches rows 778/796)

rows.en:
During training, flight mode is set to
Normal Flight, and controller settings are
reset to defaults. Please keep this in mind.
rows.notes: Normal Flight built from glossary 'Normal' + 'Real Flight Mode'. Second break moved by a word for balance; count kept. | review: refit: articles dropped, lines rebalanced; 'revert to their defaults' -> 'are reset to defaults' (matches row 755)

rows.en:
Press Up on the D-pad to nose down and
descend, and Down to nose up and climb.
rows.notes: review: refit: 'dip/raise the nose' -> 'nose down/up'; second 'on the D-pad' dropped

rows.en: Press Left or Right on the D-pad to turn.

Hold the L button and press Left or Right
on the D-pad to yaw.
(Real Flight only)
rows.notes: review: refit: line break moved (matches row 854)

rows.en:
Press the × button to boost.
You can keep boosting until the
boost gauge is full.
rows.notes: Source: boost usable until the gauge reaches maximum; kept literally (gauge fills as you boost). | review: repeated tutorial line; one rendering

rows.en:
Quickly press Up, Left or Right on the D-pad
twice in the same direction to roll
that way.

Quickly press Down on the D-pad twice
to fire reverse thrust and decelerate sharply.

Hold the △ button to
brake and slow down.
rows.notes: review: repeated tutorial line; one rendering

rows.en:
Push the analog stick up
to transform into Fighter mode.

That covers the basics of Fighter mode.
Note: in this training you can't transform
into any mode other than Fighter.
rows.notes: review: refit: 'basic controls for' -> 'basics of'; 'Note that' -> 'Note:'

rows.en:
Now go ahead and begin your
Fighter mode flight training.

Training ends when you reach
the target area or time runs out.
rows.notes: review: repeated tutorial line; majority form | review: refit: line break moved

rows.en: Let's go over the basics of Battroid mode.
rows.notes: review: refit: as row 741

rows.en:
During training, the controller settings
are reset to their defaults.
Please keep this in mind.
rows.notes: review: repeated tutorial line; majority form

rows.en:
Press Up, Down, Left or Right on the D-pad
to move forward, back, left or right.

Quickly press the D-pad twice
in the same direction to step
that way.

At the end of a step, keep holding
the D-pad to dash.
Press the × button to jump.

Quickly press the × button twice
and keep holding it to boost downward
and lose altitude.
You can dash even in mid-jump.

Push the analog stick down
to transform into Battroid mode.

That covers the basics of Battroid mode.
Note: in this training you can't transform
into any mode other than Battroid.
rows.notes: review: refit: as row 751

rows.en:
Now go ahead and begin your
Battroid mode training.
rows.notes: Source repeats 'piloting training' as in 752; 'flight' dropped because Battroid walks.

rows.en:
Training ends when you reach
the target area or time runs out.
rows.notes: review: repeated tutorial line; majority form | review: refit: line break moved

rows.en: Let's go over the basics of GERWALK mode.
rows.notes: review: refit: as row 741

rows.en:
During training, the controller settings

Please keep this in mind.
rows.notes: review: repeated tutorial line; majority form

rows.en: Press Left or Right on the D-pad to turn.

Quickly press the D-pad twice
in the same direction to step
that way.

At the end of a step,
keep holding the D-pad to dash.

Hold the × button to boost upward
and gain altitude.

In GERWALK mode, you hold your altitude
and hover.

Quickly press the × button twice
and keep holding it to boost downward
and lose altitude.

Push the analog stick left or right
to transform into GERWALK mode.

That covers the basics of GERWALK mode.
Note: in this training you can't transform
into any mode other than GERWALK.
rows.notes: review: refit: as row 751; line breaks aligned with rows 751/763

Now go ahead and begin your
GERWALK mode training.

rows.en:
Training ends when you reach

rows.en: Let's go over the basics of shooting attacks.

During training, the controller settings
are reset to their defaults.
Please keep this in mind.
rows.notes: review: repeated tutorial line; majority form

rows.en:
Quickly press and release the R button
to lock on to an enemy.

While locked on, quickly press and release
the R button again to switch your lock
to another enemy.

Hold Up on the D-pad while locking on
to switch your lock to enemy warships
or enemy aces.

Hold Down on the D-pad while locking on
to switch your lock to containers
or switches.

Press the L and R buttons together
to cancel your lock-on.

Press the □ button to attack the locked-on
enemy with your main weapon.
rows.notes: review: refit: line break moved

rows.en:
Press the ○ button to attack the locked-on
enemy with your special weapon.
rows.notes: review: refit: line break moved

rows.en:
If your unit has several special weapons,
hold the L button and press the □ button
to switch between them.
rows.notes: review: refit: 'more than one special weapon' -> 'several special weapons'

rows.en:
Some special weapons are capable of
multi-lock-on, which locks on to
several enemies at once.
rows.notes: Mechanic 'multi-lock-on' not in glossary; coined from the katakana. | review: term added to glossary

rows.en:
To multi-lock-on, hold the ○ button
to lock on to multiple enemies
within range.

Release the ○ button during multi-lock-on
to hit every enemy locked at that moment
with your special weapon.

While the locked-on enemy is ahead of you,
your lock-on level goes up.
rows.notes: Mechanic 'lock-on level' not in glossary. | review: term added to glossary | review: refit: 'in front of' -> 'ahead of'

rows.en:
Shooting with a raised lock-on level
gives you bonuses to attack power
and accuracy.

These shooting controls are the same
in Fighter, Battroid
and GERWALK modes.
That covers the basics of shooting attacks.

Training ends when you reach
the target area or time runs out.
rows.notes: review: repeated tutorial line; majority form | review: refit: line break moved

rows.en: Let's go over the basics of melee attacks.

During training, the controller settings
are reset to their defaults.
Please keep this in mind.
rows.notes: review: repeated tutorial line; majority form

rows.en:
In GERWALK and Battroid modes,
press the △ button to make a melee attack.

Press the △ button repeatedly
to chain melee attacks.

The number of hits in a combo varies
by unit and mode.
